title: "Validating scientific names"
pagetitle: "Name validation — Saíra Tutorials"
---

::: {.tut-standfirst}
Scientific names are the key that connects your records to the rest of known biodiversity. This step checks spelling, resolves synonyms and standardizes nomenclature.
:::

## Why validate names

The same taxon can appear written in many ways: with typos, old synonyms, abbreviations or without the author. For your data to combine with those of other collections, the names need to be **resolved** against a stable taxonomic reference.

## Checking the nomenclature

On the **Name validation** tab, Saíra compares each <span class="term">scientificName</span> against taxonomic backbones and classifies the result:

- **Exact** — the name matches the reference perfectly.
- **Suggestion** — a very close name was found (a likely spelling error) and a correction is proposed.
- **Synonym** — the name is valid, but there is a more current accepted name.
- **Not found** — requires manual review.

```{=html}
<ol class="steps">
  <li><strong>Run the check.</strong>
    <p>Saíra processes the list of names and shows a summary by status.</p></li>
  <li><strong>Review the suggestions.</strong>
    <p>For each name with a suggestion or synonym, accept the proposed correction or keep the original.</p></li>
  <li><strong>Handle the not-found ones.</strong>
    <p>Correct them manually, confirm they are right (e.g. a recently described taxon) or flag them for later review.</p></li>
</ol>
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## Accept in bulk
When many records share the same recurring error, accept the correction once and apply it to all identical cases — instead of reviewing row by row.
:::

```{=html}
<figure class="shot">
  <div class="frame"><span class="ph-label">screenshot · name validation</span></div>
  <figcaption><b>Figure 1.</b> Name validation screen, with the status of each taxon and the suggested corrections.</figcaption>
</figure>
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## The taxonomic decision is yours
Suggestions are automatic, but the authority belongs to the specialist. In groups with unstable taxonomy, check the proposals before accepting them en masse.
:::
